pages.text: Every kill feeds your $(l)souls$(), shown on screen: a little for small fry, five for most things, forty for the elite, a hundred and fifty for lords and bosses.$(br2)Spend souls with the $(l)Merchant$() and $(l)Blacksmith$() in Firelink. No refunds.$(br2)$(l)Lord Souls$() are something else: items carried by great beasts, used to forge legendary weapons.
